case: closure, editability labels, notices, variant manifests, profile update vs accepted export

checks.name: labels
checks.expect: baked, baked, baked, source-editable, property-editable, clip-editable, unavailable, unavailable; a rendered 3D shot is never called an editable rig

checks.name: notices
checks.setup: licence ids for an MIT component and an unresolved one
checks.expect: notice for the first; the second under external_requirements with its status; GSAP blocker appears in distribution_gate and is not hidden

checks.name: variant manifest
checks.expect: manifest.variant links parent creative revision digests and records approved copy / timing changes

checks.name: shared asset update
checks.expect: only dependent variants stale; delivered exports keep their manifests and files

checks.name: profile update
checks.expect: an accepted export's manifest still names the profile id, version and digest it was built with; a registry change never edits it

checks.name: no private research
checks.expect: manifest.not_included states the exclusion; research and provider logs absent from the folder
